title: Failover KPI Baseline (Hosted API + Dedicated) — Reliability Program Q1–Q2 2026
content:
Last updated: 2026-01-20 (post Game Day 1 data backfill)
Owner: Aisha Bello (SLO dashboards)  |  DRI for this sheet: Rafael Mendes (SRE delivery)

Purpose
- Establish baseline KPIs for regional failover before the automation upgrade (signal hierarchy + controller guardrails).
- Quantify where time is spent today (detect → confirm → decide → execute → stabilize).
- Baseline customer impact during regional impairment: error budget burn (availability) + tail latency burn.
- Define target deltas for Q1–Q2 2026 rollout (Hosted API + Dedicated).

Notes / methodology (important)
- “Failover” here includes: (a) explicit routing policy flips across regions, (b) partial drain/evacuation of pools, (c) traffic shedding/circuit-breaker state changes that redirect load.
- Times are derived from (1) incident timeline + Slack timestamps, (2) gateway/routing audit logs when available, (3) dashboard annotations when available. Several older events are approximate.
- Error budget burn is computed against the 2026 multi-region availability SLO definition, but older incidents were re-scored from raw request metrics.
- For Dedicated, we separate “control-plane failover” (routing/policy) from “pool drain/evacuation” because customer impact often tracks drain completeness.

Sheet 1 — KPI definitions
KPI | Definition | How measured | Owner
---|---|---|---
T_detect | Time from first material symptom to trigger firing / on-call aware | burn-rate alert fire time, reachability probe drop, or first page | SRE
T_confirm | Time from on-call aware to confirmed region-level impairment (vs local/service issue) | incident timeline + triage notes | SRE
T_decide | Time from confirmation to decision (approve automation / choose target region / scope) | Slack “decision made” timestamp | SRE + routing
T_execute | Time from decision to traffic shift effective (p50 routing change observed) | routing metrics + policy flip audit event | routing
T_stabilize | Time from effective shift to stable state (no oscillation; error rate back within SLO guardrails) | error rate/latency stabilization + no flip for hold-down window | SRE
Total TTM | T_detect + T_confirm + T_decide + T_execute + T_stabilize | derived | SRE
EB burn (avail) | % of monthly error budget consumed during event window | SLO toolkit backfill, 1m granularity | SLO dashboards
Burn rate peak | Peak multi-window burn rate during event | alert rule output | Observability
Customer impact | notable external symptoms (5xx, timeouts, stream disconnects, elevated tail) | support tickets + API metrics | Support liaison

Sheet 2 — Historical events baseline (selected)
Event ID | Date (UTC) | Product | Primary region | Target region | Type | Root symptom | T_detect | T_confirm | T_decide | T_execute | T_stabilize | Total TTM | EB burn (avail) | Peak burn rate | Notes / customer impact
---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---
RF-2025-07-18-01 | 2025-07-18 | Hosted API | us-east | eu-west | Unplanned | cloud provider network packet loss + elevated 5xx | 10m | 14m | 8m | 6m | 22m | 60m | 18% | 28x | Manual routing flip; confusing signals (latency alarms fired but reachability probes were green). 2 enterprise tickets citing timeouts.
RF-2025-08-29-02 | 2025-08-29 | Hosted API | eu-west | us-east | Unplanned | regional capacity exhaustion (GPU queue backlog) | 6m | 9m | 7m | 9m | 18m | 49m | 11% | 16x | On-call hesitated due to fear of overload in us-east; no clear capacity headroom metric. Elevated p99 for ~35m.
RF-2025-10-03-01 | 2025-10-03 | Dedicated | eu-west | us-east | Unplanned | cross-zone routing instability | 12m | 18m | 15m | 11m | 55m | 111m | 7% | 9x | Partial drain attempted; drain sequencing unclear. 1 customer asked for audit trail of actions.
RF-2025-11-22-01 | 2025-11-22 | Hosted API | us-east | eu-west | Unplanned | control-plane degradation (policy eval lag) | 9m | 20m | 12m | 14m | 40m | 95m | 22% | 34x | Failover attempted but policy engine evaluation inconsistent; oscillation observed (2 flips within 20m). Large alert noise.
RF-2025-12-06-01 | 2025-12-06 | Dedicated | us-east | eu-west | Unplanned | scheduled maintenance overran + local saturation | 5m | 10m | 20m | 16m | 70m | 121m | 9% | 12x | Required manual approvals across teams; drain progress not visible, customer comms delayed.
RF-2026-01-15-GD1 | 2026-01-15 | Hosted API + Dedicated | us-east | eu-west | Planned (Game Day 1) | controlled traffic shift + drain rehearsal | 1m | 3m | 4m | 5m | 14m | 27m | 2% | 6x | Planned test still caused transient 5xx for a subset of tenants + streaming disconnects. Trigger false-positive dampening improved but rollback timer too aggressive.

Sheet 3 — Aggregate baseline (last 6 unplanned events sampled)
Metric | Hosted API (median) | Hosted API (p90) | Dedicated (median) | Dedicated (p90) | Notes
---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---
T_detect | 8m | 12m | 9m | 13m | Detection often driven by error burn; reachability probes underutilized / inconsistent.
T_confirm | 15m | 20m | 16m | 22m | Biggest gap: distinguishing “region event” vs “single service” vs “tenant-specific.”
T_decide | 10m | 18m | 18m | 25m | Decision slows when capacity headroom uncertain or approval needed.
T_execute | 9m | 15m | 12m | 20m | Execution includes policy edits + propagation; also DNS/steering limitations depending on route.
T_stabilize | 30m | 55m | 60m | 90m | Oscillation/overload in target region is dominant driver.
Total TTM | 85m | 120m | 120m | 165m | Current baseline used for target deltas.
EB burn (avail) | 14% | 22% | 8% | 11% | Hosted burns higher due to shared tier blast radius.

Sheet 4 — Target deltas (Q1–Q2 2026) for failover automation upgrade
KPI | Current baseline | Target (Phase 1: limited routes/tenants) | Target (Phase 2: broader rollout) | Primary lever(s)
---|---|---|---|---
T_detect | 8–12m | <2m | <60s | reachability + burn corroboration; faster signal pipeline
T_confirm | 15–20m | <5m | <3m | region health aggregator; dashboards that separate reachability vs app errors
T_decide | 10–25m | <3m | <2m | deterministic policy evaluation; clear action recommendation; approval hooks configurable
T_execute | 9–20m | <5m | <3m | controller automation; faster propagation; DNS TTL tuning where applicable
T_stabilize | 30–90m | <15m | <10m | capacity gating; circuit breakers; retry-after; anti-flap/hold-down tuned
Total TTM | 85–165m | <30m | <20m | end-to-end automation + guardrails
EB burn (avail) | 8–22% | <5% | <2% | reduce event duration + overload cascades
Oscillation (policy flips) | 0–2+ flips/event | 0 flips unless new evidence | 0 flips unless new evidence | anti-flap rate limits; rollback semantics

Sheet 5 — Gaps / action items (as of 2026-01-20)
Area | Gap observed | Impact on KPIs | Owner | Next step
---|---|---|---|---
Signals | latency-only triggers too noisy; reachability not treated as authoritative | slower confirm; false positives | Victor Alvarez + Allison Grant | implement corroboration rules per ADR-042; ensure probes feed region health
Capacity | no single “safe to fail over” headroom view per region/tier | slow decide; risk overload | Vanessa Ortiz | integrate capacity signal into routing; publish headroom dashboard
Auditability | incomplete annotations in dashboards; older incidents missing exact flip times | KPI measurement unreliable | Sergio Costa | automation-driven annotations; audit event schema adoption
Rollback | rollback/hold-down timers caused early revert in rehearsal | oscillation risk; longer stabilize | Miles Thornton | tune anti-flap + rollback semantics per ADR-043; add per-tenant safety limits
Client behavior | streaming reconnect behavior caused visible disconnects during redirect | customer impact spikes | Peter Holtz + Vikram Singh | ship streaming redirect idempotency fix; update retry-after guidance
Comms | inconsistent internal/external messaging for planned tests | support load, confusion | Dev Patel | align comms playbook + status templates; pre-notify enterprise accounts

Raw data notes (for reviewers)
- If you need the backing timestamps: see Slack threads + incident timeline exports; ping Aisha for the backfill worksheet.
- Game Day 1 (RF-2026-01-15-GD1) details are in the controlled failover results doc; numbers above are from dashboard annotation + routing audit events, not from memory.

Open questions
1) For “T_detect” do we count first automated alert only, or first engineer report (Support ping)? Current sheet uses first automated alert when available.
2) Dedicated: do we treat “service available but degraded (high latency)” as failover-worthy? Needs alignment with SLO + customer expectations.
3) How do we score partial impairment (single model family impacted) vs full regional impairment? Needs consistent tags in audit events + SLO breakdown.

Changelog
- 2026-01-20: added RF-2026-01-15-GD1, updated aggregate stats, added gaps from retro threads.
- 2026-01-03: initial baseline populated from 2025 incidents + support tickets; approximated some older timestamps.
